college: Bhivarabai Sawant College of Engineering and Research
venue: Seminar Hall, 3rd Floor, A-Building, BSCOER Pune

quote.meaning: Lead me from darkness into light

dressCodeNote: Come dressed in your favourite soft pastel shades — pinks, mints, lavenders, baby blues, and peaches — and let's make the celebration as colorful as our gratitude!

message.lead: On this special occasion of Teachers' Day, we want to take a moment to express our deepest gratitude for everything you do for us.
paragraphs: Your guidance, encouragement, and dedication inspire us every single day to push beyond our limits and achieve our fullest potential.
Beyond the lectures and coursework, it is your mentorship, patience, and warmth that shape our journey as engineers and as human beings.
Thank you for illuminating our paths and believing in us even when we doubted ourselves. We are truly fortunate to learn under your inspiring leadership.
message.closing: Wishing you a very Happy Teachers' Day!
message.signature:
With immense gratitude & respect,
Team Aces (Computer Engineering Students)

studentMessage.lead: Let's come together to express our heartfelt gratitude and celebrate the amazing teachers and mentors of our Computer Engineering Department!
paragraphs: Teachers' Day is our special opportunity to honor the professors, lecturers, and technical staff who guide, inspire, and shape our future each day.
Join us for an uplifting celebration packed with heartfelt tributes, fun interactive activities, and memorable moments with our faculty.
Please note the Pastel Dress Code and make sure to take your seats in the Seminar Hall by 9:45 AM sharp so we can begin on time.
studentMessage.closing: Let's make this day unforgettable for our teachers!
studentMessage.signature:
With enthusiasm & unity,
Team Aces (ACES Student Committee)
Department of Computer Engineering
